summary: This PR adds a --skip-checks option to management commands, but introduces a behavioral regression risk due to the removal of the 'skip_checks' option from BaseCommand's base_stealth_options.

issues.description: Removal of 'skip_checks' option from BaseCommand's base_stealth_options may break existing behavior where commands are run with the 'skip_checks' stealth option.
The added --skip-checks option is not documented in the management command help messages.
No tests are added to cover the new --skip-checks option.
